quests.question: We had ___ early flight to catch, so we left the house at dawn.
quests.sentence: We had ___ early flight to catch, so we left the house at dawn.
quests.hint: Listen to the sound at the start of 'early'.
quests.explanation: 'Early' starts with a vowel sound, so it takes 'an'. We say 'an early flight'.

quests.question: There was a long line at the check-in counter, and ___ line moved very slowly.
quests.sentence: There was a long line at the check-in counter, and ___ line moved very slowly.
quests.hint: This line was already mentioned once.
quests.explanation: The second mention of a noun takes 'the'. 'The line' points back to that same check-in line.

quests.question: Most travelers go through ___ security before boarding their flight.
quests.sentence: Most travelers go through ___ security before boarding their flight.
quests.hint: Think of security as a process here, not a specific place.

quests.question: They crossed ___ narrow stone bridge over the river.
quests.sentence: They crossed ___ narrow stone bridge over the river.
quests.hint: 'Narrow' starts with a consonant sound.
quests.explanation: 'Narrow' begins with a consonant sound, so it takes 'a'. We say 'a narrow bridge'.

quests.question: The explorers followed ___ Amazon River deep into the rainforest.
quests.sentence: The explorers followed ___ Amazon River deep into the rainforest.
quests.hint: River names usually come with this article.
quests.explanation: Rivers, oceans, and seas take 'the' - the Amazon River, the Pacific Ocean. This is different from single mountains or lakes, which usually don't.

quests.question: Every winter, skiers travel to ___ Switzerland for the mountains.
quests.sentence: Every winter, skiers travel to ___ Switzerland for the mountains.
quests.hint: Most country names stand alone.
quests.explanation: Most country names, including Switzerland, take no article. We say 'to Switzerland', not 'to the Switzerland'.

quests.question: He scored ___ incredible three-pointer right at the buzzer.

quests.question: Our team played two games last week, and ___ second game was much closer.
quests.sentence: Our team played two games last week, and ___ second game was much closer.
quests.hint: 'Second' is an ordinal number.
quests.explanation: Ordinal numbers like second, third, and last are almost always paired with 'the'. We say 'the second game'.

quests.question: In gym class, we usually play ___ basketball on Fridays.
quests.sentence: In gym class, we usually play ___ basketball on Fridays.
quests.hint: Sport names don't take an article.

quests.question: She has ___ challenging class right after lunch.

quests.explanation: 'Challenging' begins with a consonant sound, so it takes 'a'. We say 'a challenging class'.

quests.question: Two students helped set up the science fair, and ___ younger one built the volcano model.
quests.sentence: Two students helped set up the science fair, and ___ younger one built the volcano model.

quests.question: This term, we are studying ___ history and geography.
quests.sentence: This term, we are studying ___ history and geography.

quests.question: The waiter recommended ___ unusual dish made with local spices.

quests.explanation: 'Unusual' starts with a vowel sound, so it takes 'an'. We say 'an unusual dish'.

quests.question: We ordered two desserts, and ___ chocolate one disappeared first.

quests.question: On Friday nights, my parents enjoy having ___ dinner at their favorite restaurant.

quests.question: We had ___ unplanned adventure exploring the new bike trail.
quests.sentence: We had ___ unplanned adventure exploring the new bike trail.

quests.explanation: 'Unplanned' starts with a vowel sound, so it takes 'an'. We say 'an unplanned adventure'.

quests.question: We visited two new cafes this weekend, and ___ first one had much better coffee.

quests.question: On weekends, my brother likes to go ___ hiking in the hills.

quests.question: I need to mail ___ heavy package to my cousin today.
quests.sentence: I need to mail ___ heavy package to my cousin today.
quests.hint: 'Heavy' starts with a consonant sound.
quests.explanation: 'Heavy' begins with a consonant sound, so it takes 'a'. We say 'a heavy package'.

quests.question: The town built a new library last year, and ___ building has huge glass windows.
quests.sentence: The town built a new library last year, and ___ building has huge glass windows.

quests.explanation: Once something is introduced, later mentions use 'the'. 'The building' refers back to that same library.

quests.question: Many people in our town go to ___ work by bicycle.

quests.question: She painted ___ vivid sunset for the art contest.

quests.hint: 'Vivid' starts with a consonant sound.
quests.explanation: 'Vivid' begins with a consonant sound, so it takes 'a'. We say 'a vivid sunset'.

quests.question: Of all her paintings, this landscape is ___ most colorful.

quests.question: My uncle spends his weekends painting ___ landscapes of the countryside.

quests.question: This winter has been ___ remarkably mild one so far.

quests.question: Farmers always welcome ___ rain after a long dry spell.

quests.question: We boarded ___ crowded train to the coast.

quests.hint: 'Crowded' starts with a consonant sound.
quests.explanation: 'Crowded' begins with a consonant sound, so it takes 'a'. We say 'a crowded train'.

quests.sentence: Many commuters prefer to travel by ___ train rather than by car.
